scene_frontend.theme_title: MiniMax Music 3 Song & Music Generation [Main prompt: music style & arrangement; Additional prompt: structured lyrics]

prompt.Guofeng / Classical Poetry:
Global Metadata: Chinese-style Mandopop ballad (guofeng), 70 BPM, minor pentatonic melody, slow 4/4, solitary autumn dusk mood.
Vocal Details: single male tenor, breathy low register, half-voiced verse delivery, clear Mandarin diction forward, gentle falling portamento and light vibrato at phrase ends, wordless backing pad only in the second chorus.
Arrangement: solo guzheng arpeggio and erhu motif in the intro; verse voice over sparse guzheng and pipa ornaments; chorus opens with warm strings and erhu counter-melody; second chorus adds deep frame drum and harmonized backing; outro strips back to erhu and a single guzheng harmonic.
prompt.Mandopop / Indie Rock Vocal:
Global Metadata: Modern Mandopop indie pop-rock anthem, 118 BPM, F major, driving 4/4 groove, nostalgic neon night highway atmosphere building from intimate confession to soaring catharsis.
Vocal Details: expressive female mezzo-soprano lead vocal, warm chest-voice intimacy in verses, bright open mixed-belt chorus with subtle double-tracked harmonies and airy ad-libs in the bridge.
Arrangement: clean chorus-drenched electric guitar arpeggio and muted bass pulse in intro; tight live snare and warm synth pad enter in pre-chorus; full overdriven guitar chords, punchy acoustic drums, and shimmering octave lead in chorus; quiet piano breakdown in bridge before final full-band lift and ringing guitar fade.
prompt.Instrumental / Soundtrack:
Global Metadata: Cinematic neo-classical and ambient orchestral soundtrack, 84 BPM, D minor, 3/4 waltz pulse, misty dawn over mountain sea of clouds, contemplative and luminous.
Vocal Details: purely instrumental, no vocals, no spoken words.
Arrangement: delicate felt piano solo ostinato in the intro; solo cello enters with a warm lyrical theme; swelling chamber strings, French horn pad, and subtle harp arpeggios lift the main theme to a panoramic climax; gentle celesta harmonics and solo piano resolve into quiet stillness.
prompt.Full-Length Song (Tiled Low-VRAM):
Global Metadata: Epic cinematic Mandopop ballad with orchestral-band fusion, 76 BPM, E minor modulating to G major in the final chorus, 4/4, sweeping emotional journey from quiet memory to triumphant dawn.
Vocal Details: warm baritone male vocal with intimate close-mic breath in verses, soaring resonant tenor lift in choruses, layered choir-like vocal pads in the bridge and final chorus.
Arrangement: solo grand piano and distant ambient pad in intro; acoustic guitar fingerpicking and cello counter-line in first verse; brushed drums, fretless bass, and string quartet in first chorus; full orchestral strings, timpani swell, and melodic electric guitar solo in bridge; key-change final chorus with full band and strings, resolving to solo piano outro.

agent_prompt.Guofeng / Classical Poetry: Write a structured English music caption for MiniMax Music 3 using exactly three sections: Global Metadata, Vocal Details, and Arrangement. Global Metadata specifies genre, BPM, key/scale, time signature, and overall mood. Vocal Details specifies vocal range, delivery nuances, phrasing, and diction (or explicitly 'purely instrumental, no vocals' for instrumentals). Arrangement describes instrumentation and dynamic progression chronologically across intro, verse, chorus, bridge, and outro. Lyrics are provided separately in the additional prompt field; do not repeat lyric lines in the caption. Return only the final English caption without commentary.
agent_prompt.Mandopop / Indie Rock Vocal: Write a structured English music caption for MiniMax Music 3 using exactly three sections: Global Metadata, Vocal Details, and Arrangement. Global Metadata specifies genre, BPM, key, time signature, and emotional arc. Vocal Details specifies lead vocal timbre, register transitions, and backing harmonies. Arrangement describes band/synth instrumentation and dynamic build chronologically across intro, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge, and outro. Return only the final English caption without repeating lyrics or adding commentary.
agent_prompt.Instrumental / Soundtrack: Write a structured English instrumental soundtrack caption for MiniMax Music 3 using exactly three sections: Global Metadata, Vocal Details, and Arrangement. Global Metadata specifies soundtrack style, BPM, key, time signature, and cinematic atmosphere. Vocal Details must explicitly state 'purely instrumental, no vocals, no spoken words'. Arrangement describes specific instruments, counterpoint, dynamic swells, and resolution chronologically across intro, theme, development, climax, and outro. Return only the final English caption.
agent_prompt.Full-Length Song (Tiled Low-VRAM): Write a structured English full-length song caption for MiniMax Music 3 using exactly three sections: Global Metadata, Vocal Details, and Arrangement. Emphasize multi-section dynamic evolution (intro, dual verses, choruses, instrumental interlude, bridge, modulated final chorus, and outro) so instrumentation develops naturally without sounding repetitive. Return only the final English caption without repeating lyrics or adding commentary.
